placeholderTitle: A second perspective, quietly taking shape.
placeholderBody: This is the beginning of a private, local space for noticing how your experiences connect over time.

database.error: Local storage could not be initialized

capture.composeBody: Write naturally. Nothing becomes structured long-term data until you review it and choose Save.
capture.naturalInputPlaceholder: Describe what happened, what you noticed, or what went through your mind…
capture.temporaryNote: This original text is temporary review context and is not saved.
capture.originalTextNote: Use this as a reference. Only the fields you confirm below will be saved.
capture.contextPrompt: What was happening? What was the context? (optional)
capture.observationPrompt: What did you actually see, hear, or experience?
capture.thoughtPrompt: What went through your mind at the time?
capture.emptyValidation: Add at least one context, experienced detail, or thought. Remove any blank added fields.

errors.emptyCapture: Add at least one item before saving.
errors.invalidSituation: The context could not be saved. Check the text and try again.
errors.invalidObservation: One experienced detail could not be saved. Check it and try again.
errors.invalidThought: One thought could not be saved. Check it and try again.
errors.subjectInvariant: The local user record is inconsistent. No new information was saved.
errors.captureConflict: This capture conflicts with an existing local record. No partial information was saved.
errors.storageUnavailable: Local storage is not ready. No information was saved.
errors.clockUnavailable: The current time is unavailable. No information was saved.
errors.saveFailed: The capture could not be saved. No partial information was kept.

history.title: Saved contexts, experienced details, and thoughts
history.scope: This view shows these three kinds of structured records. It is not a complete view of all data NOUS holds.
history.order: Newest saved first within each section. Save order does not represent when events occurred.
history.empty: No saved contexts, experienced details, or thoughts yet.
history.standaloneObservations: Experienced details without a saved context
history.conviction: How strongly you believed this thought at the time: {value}/100

errors.subjectInvariant: The local user record is inconsistent, so no saved records were loaded.
errors.dataInconsistent: Some saved records are inconsistent, so this view could not be loaded safely.
errors.loadFailed: Saved records could not be loaded.

semanticComparison.title: Compare records
semanticComparison.intro: Choose saved thoughts or experienced details, then describe how each selected record relates to one record you choose as the starting point. These are your judgments for this comparison only.
semanticComparison.notSaved: This comparison is not saved. Leaving this view or reloading the app discards it.
semanticComparison.frameGuidance: Write the angle for this comparison. Editing it after you answer a question clears those answers; your selected records remain.
semanticComparison.chooseMode: Choose Thoughts or Experienced details to see available records.
semanticComparison.noThoughts: No saved thoughts are available for this comparison yet.
semanticComparison.noObservations: No saved experienced details are available for this comparison yet.
semanticComparison.staleNotice: A selected record changed. Its earlier content and answers are no longer used. Select the current record again to compare it.
semanticComparison.needAnother: Select at least one more record to compare.
semanticComparison.anchorIntro: Compare each record below only with this starting record:
semanticComparison.comparabilityQuestion: Does comparing these records make sense under your chosen angle?
semanticComparison.meaningQuestion: In this respect, how do their expressed meanings relate?
semanticComparison.experienceQuestion: Might these records describe the same underlying experience?
semanticComparison.summaryInvalid: The earlier reviewed summary is no longer current. Review the current records and your remaining answers before reviewing again.
semanticComparison.incomplete: Choose a starting record and answer each applicable question before reviewing a summary. ‘Cannot tell’ is a complete answer.
semanticComparison.comparisonsTitle: Each comparison with the starting record
semanticComparison.limitations: These are your judgments under this comparison angle, using only the selected records. Each relation is with the starting record; no relation among the other records was inferred. Different experiences do not establish independent evidence. NOUS inferred no recurrence, Candidate, Pattern, cause, confidence, or event chronology. This comparison is not saved.

errors.subjectInvariant: The local user record is inconsistent, so current records could not be loaded.
errors.dataInconsistent: Saved records are inconsistent, so this comparison cannot load them safely.
errors.loadFailed: Current saved records could not be loaded. The previous summary is no longer current.

candidateReview.title: Candidate review
candidateReview.intro: Examine a possible recurring structure using only the saved records you choose. Your wording and evidence roles are your own; NOUS does not decide whether a Pattern exists here.
candidateReview.notSaved: This review is not saved. Leaving this view or reloading the app discards it.
candidateReview.wordingGuidance: Keep the claim about your own experience and its context. For example, ‘In these team projects, I tended to withdraw after conflict’ is narrower than a label about who you are. This guidance does not change your wording.
candidateReview.claimScopePlaceholder: Which situations or conditions might this claim apply to?
candidateReview.scopeGuidance: The claim scope is what you write here. The analysis scope below is only the records selected for this review; those records do not automatically support a broader claim.
candidateReview.roleMeaning: You may assign one role to each selected record, or leave it unclassified. These are your classifications, not proof or a score.
candidateReview.noSources: No saved situations, experienced details, or thoughts are available to review yet.
candidateReview.situationDualRole: This situation can be selected as a source itself. For linked records below, it also supplies context; they do not automatically represent separate experiences.
candidateReview.standaloneObservations: Experienced details without a linked situation
candidateReview.subjectiveConviction: Your reported conviction in this thought at the time: {value}/100
candidateReview.reviewCurrentSource: The earlier selection is stale. Select this current representation again to review it; its old role will not carry over.
candidateReview.staleNotice: Some selected sources changed or disappeared. Review the current records before using a summary.
candidateReview.sourceNotFound: Source no longer exists; review again
candidateReview.reviewInvalid: Enter Candidate wording and Claim scope, and select at least one current record before reviewing a summary.
candidateReview.analysisScopeExplanation: Only the records listed below were reviewed. The linked situation may be context as well as a selected source.
candidateReview.limitedSelection: Other saved records were not reviewed here; absence of a counterexample here is not proof that none exists.
candidateReview.dependence: Several selected records may describe the same experience. Their number does not establish independent support or recurrence.
candidateReview.noChronology: Save order does not establish when the experiences happened or whether anything changed over time.
candidateReview.noConclusion: NOUS has not generated a psychological conclusion or confirmed a Pattern.

errors.subjectInvariant: The local user record is inconsistent, so current records could not be loaded.
errors.dataInconsistent: Saved records are inconsistent, so this review cannot load them safely.
errors.loadFailed: Current saved records could not be loaded. The previous summary is no longer current.

deletion.title: Permanently delete this record?
deletion.consequence: Deleting this record also removes its correction history from the current NOUS database. This cannot be undone in the current version.

errors.targetNotFound: This record could not be found. Nothing was deleted.
errors.staleDelete: This record changed after you opened it. Reload and review it before deleting.
errors.dependencyBlocked: This record is still used by other saved NOUS data, so it cannot be safely deleted yet.
errors.subjectInvariant: The local user record is inconsistent. Nothing was deleted.
errors.dataInconsistent: Saved data is inconsistent. Nothing was deleted.
errors.storageUnavailable: Local storage is not ready. Nothing was deleted.
errors.deleteConflict: The deletion conflicted with local data. Nothing was deleted.
errors.deleteFailed: The record could not be deleted. No partial deletion was kept.

portability.title: Export and backup
portability.exportExplanation: Create a portable JSON copy of saved NOUS user data, including relationships and correction provenance.
portability.backupExplanation: Create a consistent SQLite copy of the current NOUS database. In-app Restore is not available yet.
portability.privacy: The file is saved where you choose. NOUS does not automatically upload it or add NOUS-specific encryption.

errors.subjectInvariant: The local user record is inconsistent. No export was created.
errors.dataInconsistent: Saved data is inconsistent. A portable export could not be created safely.
errors.serializationFailed: The portable data could not be prepared.
errors.destinationUnavailable: This location cannot safely receive the file. Choose another location.
errors.destinationExists: A file already exists there. Choose another filename or location.
errors.exportFailed: The export could not be created.
errors.backupFailed: The database backup could not be created.

correction.title: Correct inaccurate record
correction.explanation: Use this when NOUS stored this record inaccurately. If your view changed later, add a new record instead of rewriting the past. This does not delete the record.
correction.conviction: How strongly you believed this thought at the time (optional, 0–100)
correction.priorMeaning: Previous values are inaccurate NOUS representations, not true past user states. Context labels identify logical saved contexts using their current wording.

errors.targetNotFound: This saved record could not be found. No correction was saved.
errors.invalidCorrection: Check the corrected content, context, and conviction value.
errors.noChanges: The corrected representation is unchanged. No correction was saved.
errors.staleCorrection: This record changed after you opened it. Reload before confirming a correction.
errors.evidenceReferenceBlocked: This record is already used as a deliberate evidence source, so it cannot be corrected here. No changes were saved.
errors.subjectInvariant: The local user record is inconsistent. No correction was saved.
errors.dataInconsistent: Saved records are inconsistent. No correction was saved.
errors.storageUnavailable: Local storage is not ready. No correction was saved.
errors.correctionConflict: The correction conflicted with local data. No changes were saved.
errors.clockUnavailable: The current time is unavailable. No correction was saved.
errors.saveFailed: The correction could not be saved. No partial changes were kept.
